tools.name: glass_vision
tools.description: Advanced visual intelligence for Windows: screen capture, OCR, UI element detection, and comprehensive screen analysis. Operations: capture_screen, analyze_screen, extract_text, detect_elements, find_clickable_regions

region.description: Region to capture {x, y, width, height}

imagePath.description: Path to image file for OCR

elementTypes.description: Filter by element types: button, textbox, label, etc.

includeText.description: Include text context for each region

tools.name: glass_drawing
tools.description: Visual overlay and drawing engine for real-time annotations, highlights, and visual feedback on Windows desktop. Operations: draw_overlay, highlight_element, draw_annotation, clear_overlays, screenshot_with_annotations

overlayId.description: Specific overlay ID to clear (empty = clear all)

region.description: Region to capture {x, y, width, height}

tools.name: glass_windows
tools.description: Windows management operations including focus, text extraction, positioning, and text input. Operations: list, focus, extract_text, send_text

query.description: Optional query for help or system information

title.description: The title of the window to focus

exact.description: Whether to match the title exactly

windowHandle.description: The handle of the window to extract text from

text.description: The text to send to the window

tools.name: glass_clipboard
tools.description: Enhanced clipboard operations for text and data management. Operations: get_text, set_text

text.description: The text to set in the clipboard

tools.name: glass_files
tools.description: Basic file system operations including existence checks, reading, and writing. Operations: exists, read, write

tools.name: glass_interact
tools.description: Smart interaction engine for clicking, typing, gestures, and context-aware input with Windows elements. Operations: smart_click, smart_type, drag_drop, scroll, send_keys

target.description: Click target: {x, y} coordinates, {elementId: string}, or {text: string}

tools.name: glass_workflows
tools.description: Comprehensive Windows workflow automation engine for recording, managing, and executing automation sequences. Operations: create_workflow, start_recording, record_action, stop_recording, execute_workflow, list_workflows, update_workflow, delete_workflow

steps.description: Array of workflow steps with type, action, and parameters

variables.description: Default variable values for the workflow

workflowName.description: Name for the workflow being recorded

actionType.description: Action type: click, type, wait, capture, verify, condition

value.description: Action value (text to type, wait duration, etc.)

save.description: Whether to save the recorded workflow

filter.description: Optional filter by tag or name pattern

sortBy.description: Sort by: name, created, lastExecuted, executionCount

updates.description: Updates to apply (description, steps, variables, tags)

confirm.description: Confirmation flag to prevent accidental deletion

tools.name: glass_system
tools.description: Deep Windows system integration - manage processes, services, registry, and system health. Operations: getSystemHealth, manageProcess, manageService, manageRegistry, getPerformanceMetrics, performSystemMaintenance

action.description: Action to perform: list, start, stop, restart, kill

tasks.description: Maintenance tasks to perform: cleanup, defrag, updates

tools.name: glass_network
tools.description: Comprehensive network automation - connectivity testing, Wi-Fi management, VPN control, interface management, and network diagnostics. Operations: testConnectivity, manageWiFi, manageNetworkInterface, runNetworkDiagnostics, manageVPN, testNetworkSpeed

testType.description: Test type: ping, traceroute, nslookup, telnet

action.description: Action: list, connect, disconnect, scan, profile

tools.name: window_list
tools.description: [LEGACY] List all open windows. Use glass_windows with operation: "list" instead. This tool will be deprecated in v11.0

query.description: Optional query for help or system information (e.g., "help", "capabilities")

tools.name: window_focus
tools.description: [LEGACY] Focus a specific window by title. Use glass_windows with operation: "focus" instead. This tool will be deprecated in v11.0

title.description: The title of the window to focus

exact.description: Whether to match the title exactly

tools.name: window_extract_text
tools.description: [LEGACY] Extract text from a window. Use glass_windows with operation: "extract_text" instead. This tool will be deprecated in v11.0

windowHandle.description: The handle of the window to extract text from

tools.name: window_extract_text_by_title
tools.description: [LEGACY] Extract text from a window by title. Use glass_windows with operation: "extract_text" instead. This tool will be deprecated in v11.0

title.description: The title of the window to extract text from

exact.description: Whether to match the title exactly

tools.name: window_send_text
tools.description: [LEGACY] Send text to a window. Use glass_windows with operation: "send_text" instead. This tool will be deprecated in v11.0

windowHandle.description: The handle of the window to send text to

text.description: The text to send to the window

tools.name: window_send_text_by_title
tools.description: [LEGACY] Send text to a window by title. Use glass_windows with operation: "send_text" instead. This tool will be deprecated in v11.0

title.description: The title of the window to send text to

text.description: The text to send to the window

exact.description: Whether to match the title exactly

tools.name: clipboard_get_text
tools.description: [LEGACY] Get clipboard text. Use glass_clipboard with operation: "get_text" instead. This tool will be deprecated in v11.0

tools.name: clipboard_set_text
tools.description: [LEGACY] Set clipboard text. Use glass_clipboard with operation: "set_text" instead. This tool will be deprecated in v11.0

tools.name: system_info
tools.description: Get system information including OS version, computer name, and hardware details

detailed.description: Whether to include detailed hardware information

tools.name: process_list
tools.description: List running processes with their IDs, names, and resource usage

filter.description: Optional filter to search for specific processes

tools.name: file_exists
tools.description: Check if a file or directory exists

path.description: The file or directory path to check

tools.name: file_read

tools.description: Write text content to a file
